sentences.text: Faheem Rashad Najm -LRB- born September 30 , 1985 -RRB- , better known by his stage name T-Pain , is an American rapper , singer , songwriter and record producer from Tallahassee , Florida .
His debut album , Rappa Ternt Sanga , was released in 2005 .	Rappa Ternt Sanga	Rappa Ternt Sanga
In 2007 , T-Pain released his second album Epiphany , which reached number one on the US Billboard 200 chart .	Epiphany	Epiphany (T-Pain album)
His third album , Thr33 Ringz , was released in 2008 .	Thr33 Ringz	Thr33 Ringz

T-Pain has also released a string of hit singles , including `` I 'm Sprung '' , `` I 'm 'n Luv -LRB- Wit a Stripper -RRB- '' , `` Buy U a Drank -LRB- Shawty Snappin ' -RRB- '' , `` Bartender '' , `` Ca n't Believe It '' , `` 5 O'Clock '' and more .	Bartender	Bartender (T-Pain song)	5 O'Clock	5 O'Clock (T-Pain song)
T-Pain has earned two Grammy Awards , alongside artists Kanye West and Jamie Foxx respectively .	Kanye West	Kanye West	Jamie Foxx	Jamie Foxx
T-Pain is the founder of the record label imprint Nappy Boy Entertainment , established in 2005 .	Nappy Boy	Nappy Boy Entertainment	Nappy Boy Entertainment	Nappy Boy Entertainment

Throughout his career as a singer , T-Pain is best known for using and popularizing the creative use of the Auto-Tune pitch correction effect , used with extreme parameter settings to create distinctive vocal sounds .	Auto-Tune	Auto-Tune	pitch correction	pitch correction
